{{Quote|Using a droid for the attack will be much less... ''messy'' than sacrificing ourselves and no one will suspect the droid of a ''Jedi''!|A [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] of this species|<ref name="Deadly Droid" />}}
This '''white-skinned species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of bipedals that possessed three-fingered hands, webbed toes and glowing blue eyes.<ref name="Deadly Droid" />

==History==
[[File:Alien_saboteurs_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Webbed toes featured by this species]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], three members of this species, who were [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] affiliated with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], were present on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Posing as [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], the three individuals planted a bomb inside [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in an [[Attempted bombing of the Senate Chamber|attempt]] to destroy the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Chamber]].<ref name="Deadly Droid" />
